title: The Law of the Sin Offering and the Guilt Offering
description: The Lord gives Moses instructions concerning the sin offering and the guilt offering for various offenses: when someone fails to give testimony, touches something unclean, swears thoughtlessly, sins unintentionally against holy things, or acts treacherously toward a neighbor through deception, theft, or a false oath. The guilty person must confess the sin, bring an appropriate sacrifice according to their means, and make restitution by adding one-fifth. The priest makes atonement, and they are forgiven.
